currentCard.prompt: У какой системы Sega были и версия со встроенным SEGA-CD, и отдельная портативная модель NOMAD с цветным ЖК-экраном?

answers.note: Saturn стала шестой домашней консолью Sega и названа в честь шестой планеты.
Nomad — портативная версия Genesis с цветным ЖК-экраном; в Японии её не выпускали.
Sega не выпускала в Японии ни GENESIS CDX, ни NOMAD.
За рубежом Master System продавалась как MASTER SYSTEM / Power Base — переработанная версия Mark III.

currentCard.explanation: Ответ — Genesis. Sega выпускала GENESIS CDX со встроенной SEGA-CD и портативную NOMAD с цветным ЖК-экраном.

literal.prompt: У какой системы Sega были и версия со встроенным SEGA-CD, и отдельная портативная модель NOMAD с цветным ЖК-экраном?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Personally re-read the complete affected L103-L111 and L161-L169 contexts. L168 explicitly binds integrated SEGA-CD GENESIS CDX and portable color-LCD NOMAD to Genesis. L166 identifies the base family. Genesis uniquely satisfies both conditions. Saturn is a separate32-bit system (Saturn L108), MasterSystem the separate MarkIII-derived system (MasterSystem L165), and Nomad the named portable derivative rather than a family with bothCDX and a separateNomad model. MentioningNOMAD permits informed role-based elimination without supplyingGenesis. All four options remain real Sega hardware names.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Saturn стала шестой домашней консолью Sega и названа в честь шестой планеты.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Saturn L108 explicitly says it was developed as Sega’s sixth home TV game system and named after the sixth planet. Note preserves both connected claims, not a made-up hardware count or a statement about MegaDrive. Useful own-Saturn naming fact.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Nomad — портативная версия Genesis с цветным ЖК-экраном; в Японии её не выпускали.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: MegaDrive L168 explicitly calls NOMAD a portableGenesis with colorLCD and states that both the listed CDX/Nomad products were unreleased inJapan. Note correctly applies that qualifier toNomad, with no invented releaseyear, screenresolution or Japanese version. Useful own-option hardware fact.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Sega не выпускала в Японии ни GENESIS CDX, ни NOMAD.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L168 lists GENESIS CDX and portableNOMAD, then says いずれも日本では未発売: neither released inJapan. New note applies this precisely to those two products, not allGenesis hardware. It is a concrete own-family release-market fact beyond the prompt’s two-variant association.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: За рубежом Master System продавалась как MASTER SYSTEM / Power Base — переработанная версия Mark III.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: MasterSystem L161-L165 identifies overseas MASTER SYSTEM / PowerBase as a design-modified SegaMarkIII. L166-L173 distinguishes omitted features and cartridge differences from the later JapaneseMasterSystem. The note’s переработанная версия is a bounded accurate summary and does not claim that every JapaneseMasterSystem feature was present overseas. Useful own-option relation.
